baseline_preprocessing.normalization: none; TuneJury internal CLAP clips/quantizes; MuQ-MuLan uses float32
baseline_preprocessing.tunejury_prompt: empty text branch (512 zeros), official waveform API
baseline_preprocessing.window_selection: equally spaced first-to-last complete window; one segment uses center
baseline_preprocessing.aggregation: unweighted mean of valid excerpt rewards and cosines

final.identical_audio_policy: Unchanged presets are re-rendered with the final CLI and verified byte-identical to baseline WAVs. Exact WAV identity establishes zero paired change without rerunning model inference; absolute fresh scores are omitted.

decisions.writer: Chiptune subdivision range 4 with a four-subdivision cap; other palettes keep range 3.
decisions.chiptune_fresh_regression: Fresh three-window reward delta is -0.0023836102; identity increases. Retained as a documented tradeoff within the shared chiptune calibration.
decisions.jazz-trio: Rejected after reward fell on both fresh seeds in the three-window protocol; source preset restored.
